screening_decisions.reason: Multicentre randomised trial in stage I endometrial carcinoma; after surgery, patients were randomised to adjuvant medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA) vs no MPA (and radiotherapy ± MPA per risk group). Meets RCT of adjuvant progestagen post-surgery.
Narrative review of progestin therapy across cancers; not an RCT and not a specific postoperative adjuvant trial.
Methodological paper on inconsistency in meta-analyses; no patient RCT or postoperative progestagen intervention.
Statistical methods chapter on meta-analysis; not a clinical RCT of adjuvant progestagen therapy.
Randomised, controlled trial: after surgery, patients with stage I/II endometrial cancer assigned to adjuvant progesterone vs no additional therapy. Directly meets inclusion.
Methodological paper on meta-analysis; not an RCT in postoperative endometrial cancer.

Randomised trial of progestogens as part of primary treatment in conjunction with surgery and radiotherapy; patients underwent operation and were randomised to progestogen vs control. Meets RCT in women who had surgery (though timing relative to surgery is less explicit).
Methods for extracting survival statistics for meta-analyses; not a clinical RCT.
Randomised, placebo-controlled adjuvant progesterone initiated within 24 hours after hysterectomy/BSO in stage I endometrial cancer. Clear postoperative RCT of progestagen.
Prospective randomised trial after hysterectomy comparing adjuvant progestagen therapy vs no therapy with 5-year follow-up. Meets inclusion.
